svg.title: Galaxian Coop
svg.desc: Simultaneous two-player co-op for Galaxian on the NES. Weapon levels W1 to W4 shown as one to four shots; player 2's orange-and-blue ship firing on the right.

g.text: Two pilots, one formation – at the same time.
weapon levels · W4 = 12-second Red Laser Overdrive
